name: FishMarket
source:
Story about the anxiety of a generation trapped by a stagnant economy. Degrees, effort, and talent often fail to open doors. Jobs vanish to AI or nepotism, leaving people like fish – valued only for the parts others can use.

[From [url=https://daynstuf.itch.io/fishmarket]Itch.io[/url]]
